items.title: 68091_Joe Turner oral history interview
items.q: Yeah, I worked with Fats Domino down in New Orleans...in the Dew Drop. ... Yeah. I made some records with him, too.

ctx.x: And you mentioned off the tape Fats Domino... having worked with him or something some place. I don't think you had mentioned that on the tape, have you?
Yeah, I worked with Fats Domino down in New Orleans...in the Dew Drop.

Ohhhh. Way back there. Uhh, when you were in New Orleans, you talked about Chicago being an all-night town, with the Club DeLisa, and New York having after-hours, and here...how about New Orleans? Was New Orleans an around-the-clock...?
